messages:
Maya Chen: Morning team — quick weekly check on Acme Corp dedicated pool. Can we get GPU hours, saturation, avg+peak queue depth, p50/p95 latency, error rate, and spend vs committed? Thinking of renewal flags. Thanks!

Raj Patel: sending what I have from billing side — committed: 4,000 GPU hours/month. Last 7d usage: 920 GPU hours. Estimated monthly run-rate ~3.9k GPU hours. Spend YTD looks inline. No overages this week.

Tasha G: usage trend: GPU hours down 8% wk/wk; daily avg 131. Usage by pool: pool-a: 68% avg, pool-b: 92% avg (spiky peaks).

Elias (SRE): queue depth snapshot past 7d: avg 3.2, peak 14 (occurred at 2024-04-03T15:23Z). Saturation p95 for pool-b reached 98% during peak window.

Maya Chen: thanks Elias. Any latency or error rate impacts during that peak?

Elias (SRE): p50 latency (token gen) 40ms, p95 220ms during the peak. Error rate (500s) rose to 0.7% for a ~45m window; baseline is ~0.05%.

Raj Patel: committed vs actual spend — they're slightly under commit right now; forecast breakeven next month if usage returns to prior levels. Renewal risk: low, but call out pool-b pressure as a potential negotiation point.

Tasha G: enablement suggestion — quick call with Acme infra to shift non-latency-critical batch jobs to off-peak and enable prefix caching for high-frequency prompts. @Raj Patel can you coordinate availability?

Raj Patel: will book a 30min enablement sync. Also looping in @deploy-bot for recent deploys — any deploys this week that could explain the spike?

deploy-bot: deploy event: 2024-04-03 15:19 UTC — model-serving v2.1.3 rolled to pool-b (canary -> 100%).

Elias (SRE): that matches the timing — v2.1.3 introduced a batching heuristic change; observed higher memory usage and backpressure on pool-b. Recommending pin to v2.1.2 for Acme until we patch the batching path.

Maya Chen: action items: 1) Raj books enablement call with Acme; 2) Elias pins pool-b to v2.1.2 and opens ticket; 3) Tasha prepares a one-pager on caching and off-peak scheduling. I'll summarize for the renewal deck.

Raj Patel: booked call for 2024-04-05 10:00 PT, invite sent to acme-eng and acme-ml. :calendar:

Tasha G: sharing draft one-pager snippet here: ```Benefits of prefix caching
- Reduces token compute by ~20-35% for repeated prompts
- Lowers p95 latency and smooths queue behavior
Config suggestion: enable prefix_cache: true on product-facing routes; monitor cache hit % and adjust TTLs.```

Elias (SRE): opened ticket CS-489 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-489. Pin complete on pool-b at 2024-04-03T16:05Z.

Maya Chen: great. Closing loop — current renewal risk: LOW (monitor pool-b closely). Next check: same time next week unless there's another spike. Thanks all :thumbsup:
